## Key Points during Reproduction

1. First, read `task_b_ee_lock_pipeline.md` to understand the transition from the head camera to the end camera lock.
2. Then, read `task_b_object_classifier.md` to distinguish between line annotations and legal RGB input during operation.
3. Check whether the default route in `solution_task_b_nav_only.py` is merely a touch/service-based processing.
4. Use the official tester to independently verify grasping, lifting, and placement, without regarding the existence of public scripts as proof of the final score.
